purpose: Teach: 宮内庁/日夜/儲ける/コネ/ドロップ/修習/総数/産婆

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、宮内庁との合同警備も対応しております
lines.en: We coordinate joint security operations with the Imperial Household Agency.
lines.style: Measured, official tone. Even pacing. Professional but not rigid. Ground-level competence being stated as fact, not boasting.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、日夜、市民を守ってくださりありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. It's truly appreciated—the police protecting citizens day and night.
lines.style: Respectful, genuinely warm. Slight pause before the dash. Steady eye contact. Not flattery, but sincere acknowledgment of difficult work.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、儲けるための職務ではない、誇り高い職務です
lines.en: Police work isn't about profit—it's a duty we take pride in.
lines.style: Quiet conviction on 'duty.' Not defensive, just stating something fundamental. Slight weight in the voice. Direct and unadorned.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。コネで採用が決まる職場ではないと存じます
lines.en: Yes. I understand it's not a position where connections decide hiring.
lines.style: Respectful and earnest. Slight formality—he's showing he knows the merit system matters. Gentle agreement, not obsequious.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、退職ドロップは少ない方が望ましいです
lines.en: It's preferable that police retention rates stay high.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact. Low emphasis—stating an operational reality. Professional calm. Not lecturing, just noting what's practical.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察の修習期間中、誠実なご姿勢ありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. I'm grateful for the sincere approach you showed during the training period.
lines.style: Warm and genuine. Slightly slower pace. Recognition of personal integrity beneath the uniform. Not flowery—just honest.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪総数を毎月集計しております
lines.en: We compile crime statistics monthly across the prefecture.
lines.style: Straightforward procedural delivery. No flourish. Factual tone. Like a routine report being noted and filed away.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。被害者支援では警察も産婆のような寄り添い心ですね
lines.en: Yes. In victim support, the police have that midwife's touch—truly present with people in pain.
lines.style: Softer register here. Genuine admiration breaking through formality. Slower. The metaphor carries real feeling. Not performative, but moved.
